name: How long does it take to see results from AEO strategies for a CPA firm?
description: Results from AEO can be seen in 3-6 months for traffic, while significant organic ranking improvements and client inquiries usually take 6-12 months.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from AEO strategies for a CPA firm?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for seeing results from AEO strategies can vary. Initial improvements in visibility and website traffic may become noticeable within 3-6 months, especially for targeted PPC campaigns. More significant and sustained organic search ranking improvements, leading to increased client inquiries, typically require 6-12 months as search engines process new content and build authority. Consistent effort and adaptation are key to long-term success.
